title: What If a Comet Hit Jupiter? We Already Watched It

scenes.text: What if a comet slammed into Jupiter? In 1994, we got to watch.
A comet orbiting Jupiter had broken into twenty-one pieces, some over three thousand feet wide.
Sixty days before impact, the pieces stretched across seven hundred ten thousand miles of space.
From July sixteenth to the twenty-second, they hit one after another, each one exploding into a fireball in Jupiter's clouds.
Dark scars appeared in the atmosphere, visible from Earth, but faded noticeably within a month.
It was the first collision between two bodies in our solar system ever observed, and Hubble found no lasting change to Jupiter.

description:
What if a comet hit Jupiter?
It already happened in July 1994, when 21 pieces of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 hit one after another over about a week.
